command: async (page) => { await page.waitForSelector("#main", {state:"attached"}); console.log(await page.locator("body").innerText()); globalThis.mentorWire=[]; page.on("request", r=>{if(r.url().includes("/api/")) globalThis.mentorWire.push({type:"request",url:r.url(),method:r.method(),body:r.postData()});}); page.on("response", async r=>{if(r.url().includes("/api/")) globalThis.mentorWire.push({type:"response",url:r.url(),status:r.status(),body:await r.text().catch(()=>"")});}); }
